It offers an integrated solution for sample procurement, agreements, and payments within a single platform.

aiResearchSummary.text: AminoChain is engaged in developing systems for managing tokenized biospecimen transfers, as described in 'Transferring blockchain-based tokens representing biospecimens.' This work details a method where a biobank node retrieves donor-associated private data from a data provider’s database, integrating it with a blockchain network to facilitate secure and efficient transfer of biospecimens. The company’s research and development centers on blockchain-enabled management of stem cell tokenization and donor participation.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $5,000,000, or 87.72% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,134,855 to $21,847,173, a 6.97x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
